title: Heterogeneous Complementarity and Team Design: The Case of Real Estate Agents
authors: Yan Xu; Mantian Mandy Hu; Junhong Chu; Andrew T. Ching
eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. Structural teamwork model with latent agent types estimated in Matlab; descriptive regressions are logits of house sale on collaboration measures and house characteristics (descriptives/code/tables.do) and areg of share of high-type collaborators on its lag with agent FE. No treatment adoption dates. Lianjia data under NDA, not shipped; only a Monte Carlo package with simulated data.
design_notes: Stata (logit, reg, areg) for descriptives; Matlab for structural estimation and counterfactuals.

specs.exclusion_reason: logit of sale on collaboration measures with agent and time dummies; no treatment adoption design

data_files_note: README.pdf: Lianjia data under NDA, available only on HKU Business School servers; the Monte Carlo folder contains simulated data for the structural model.
data_provenance_note: Original data not shipped; Monte Carlo simulated data only.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Structural paper; ineligible on design and data.
